# [Internal Review] Focus Labs Deliverables
Date: 2026-11-09 | Duration: 29.969999313354492m

## Summary
GrowthBook’s ruler-and-every-person brand archetype and guide positioning were broadly endorsed. The team favored distinctive colors such as orange, red-orange, dark green, and teal over yellow or pink, and emphasized a memorable, consistent system that works digitally and physically. Real customer or employee photography was viewed positively, provided it avoids generic stock styling. The design system must remain usable by internal staff without a full-time designer. Participants requested clearer explanations of competitor archetypes, practical examples for phrases such as “confidently take up space” and “low-key humor,” stronger audience specificity, and more grounded differentiation. Human-centered AI messaging, user-generated content, repeatable employee visuals, and a simple recurring graphic element were identified as promising marketing directions. Lyndsie planned to consolidate feedback for the agency, while the next meeting would be handled by Scott and others.

## Keywords
Brand strategy, Brand archetypes, Competitive positioning, Visual identity, Colour palette, User-generated content

## Action Items
**Lyndsie Berens**
Send consolidated feedback (28:27)

**Scott Bailey, Ashley Stirrup, and Elyse Fox**
Run next meeting (28:39)
